assignments.reason: This node is a conditional statement of faith itself ('when one has faith'). Its essential nature IS אמונה — the central concept of Package 1. It is not a separate concept; it is the operative formulation of the same faith the Rebbe describes throughout. The causal edge (224) shows it producing fearless service, but the node's own identity is faith.

assignments.node_id: אין מזיק לו שום דבר, ואינו ירא משום אדם ושום דבר, ומתפלל בחיות כראוי, ונוסע להצדיק, כי אינו מתירא ומתפחד משום ענין שבעולם
assignments.reason: This composite node describes the state of fearless, vibrant divine service — praying with vitality, traveling to the tzaddik, fearing nothing. It is the operational manifestation of ארך אפים (patient forbearance), which is already a bechina of אמונה in Package 1. Nearly identical to the existing Package 1 node 'מה שאינו ירא משום דבר, ואינו משגיח על שום בטול ובלבול בעבודתו, רק עושה את שלו'. Its essential nature is the faith-empowered perseverance that defines this Torah's single thematic cluster.

Yearning for Eretz Yisrael is, in this Torah, the practical means of attaining אמונה (edge 289: yearning → faith). But its essential nature is not merely an action; it is a devotional orientation whose object IS ארץ ישראל, a core Package 1 concept. The Rebbe links it to the prayer before Kriat Shema ('והוא יוליכנו קוממיות לארצנו'), placing it squarely in the faith-and-Land domain. Its identity is bound to the yearning for the spiritual reality that ארץ ישראל represents.

assignments.node_id: אם היה לו אמונה שלמה, והיה מאמין שהשם יתברך עומד עליו, ושומע כל דבור ודבור שיוצא מפיו, ומאזין לקול תפלתו
assignments.reason: This is an expanded description of complete faith (אמונה שלמה): believing God stands over you, hears every word, listens to your prayer. Its essential nature IS אמונה in its fullest form — the detailed specification of what the package's dominant node means in lived experience. It does not belong to a prayer domain; the prayer-awareness described here is the content of what faith entails, not a separate concept.

assignments.node_id: בודאי לא היה לו שום עצבות ועצלות וכבדות בתפלתו, ובודאי היה מתפלל כראוי
assignments.reason: This node describes the absence of sadness, laziness, and heaviness in prayer — the positive state of proper prayer. In this Torah, these negative states arise exclusively from חסרון אמונה (lack of faith), and their removal is the direct manifestation of faith's power. The node's essential nature is the faith-empowered state of divine service, not an independent 'prayer' concept. This Torah treats proper prayer as what naturally happens when faith is present, making it a manifestation of the faith domain.

assignments.node_id: זוכין להתחזק בעבודתו, ולבלי להסתכל על שום מונע ומעכב ומבלבל
assignments.reason: Strengthening in divine service and ignoring all obstacles is the summary outcome described in lines 11-12 of the Torah. It is virtually synonymous with the existing Package 1 node 'מה שאינו ירא משום דבר...'. Its nature is ארך אפים in its practical expression — the perseverance that is a bechina of אמונה. Four different cause edges (1067-1070) converge on this node from ארץ ישראל, אמונה, אריכת אפים, and כח הגודל — all Package 1 bechinot — confirming it belongs to the same thematic cluster.

This is the same concept as ארך אפים (already in Package 1), in its construct-state grammatical form (אריכת אפים = the forbearance of...). The Rebbe uses both forms interchangeably throughout the Torah. Its essential nature is patient forbearance — a core bechina of אמונה in this teaching.

Same concept as ארך אפים with the prepositional prefix ל ('to/toward forbearance'). Appears in edge 1543 as the effect of אמונה. Its essential nature is identical to the ארך אפים already in Package 1 — the quality of patient forbearance that is a bechina of faith.

The nullification of divine wrath (חרון אף). In this Torah (line 8), the Rebbe teaches that עבודה זרה brings חרון אף, while אמונה (its opposite) nullifies it. The nullification of wrath IS the transition to ארך אפים — the two are presented as inverse states ('אריכת אפים שהוא הפך החרון אף'). Its essential nature is the positive state of forbearance established when faith overcomes idolatry. It belongs to the faith-and-forbearance domain of Package 1, not to an evil package, because it represents the victory of faith, not the anger itself.
